title: Germany news: Merz to cancel UN trip amid party infighting
summary: Germany's chancellor nixxed his trip over doubts about his leadership after party losses to the AfD in state elections. Meanwhile, Defense Minister Pistorius is in Washington for talks with his US…
byline: Jon Shelton, Mark Hallam, Matt Ford, Timothy Jones

image.caption: Merz has been forced to forgo international meetings in New York to deal with fallout over his party's flagging popularity at home Image: dts Nachrichtenagentur/IMAGO

blocks.text: Germany and US to boost arms projects cooperation

blocks.caption: Washington and Berlin were keen to complement one another in producing state-of-the-art weapons systems, said Pistorius (left)Image: Kay Nietfeld/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius said he had a "good discussion" with US counterpart Pete Hegseth on Tuesday and that the two had signed a declaration of intent for cooperation on future arms projects.

"Germany and the United States agree that the current security challenges require a robust and mutually beneficial, closely interlinked defense industrial base on both sides of the Atlantic," said Pistorius.
He said Washington and Berlin were keen to complement one another in producing state-of-the-art weapons systems, components and complex munitions.
The declaration covers the development, production, licensed production and maintenance of defense equipment, setting a political framework for future projects.
Pistorius said the agreement also aims to strengthen supply chains, review technology transfer rules and expand research and development cooperation.

High demand for defense equipment, he added, requires increased production capacity, quick delivery and reliable supply on both sides of the Atlantic to ensure supply security and operational readiness.
